verdict.rationale: Delegated session creation is a fair question for an agent platform with Cloud and Enterprise tiers, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an engineering lead creating sessions on behalf of other users. The API, Enterprise SSO, the Slack-triggered conversations and the Agent Server HTTP API are adjacent features, and none of them shows impersonation, delegation or org-level user assignment of sessions.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create agent sessions on behalf of other users in my organization
